plugins.changelog: Bounds catalog metadata reads to 128 items per query instead of loading an entire on-demand library with image and watch-history joins. Uses native physical-root IDs for correctly scoped ID discovery, preserves provider identities and episode grouping, and safely handles empty physical roots. Adds real PostgreSQL coverage with large Unicode metadata and the provider's split-query/cache readers, alongside the Continue Watching and settings fixes.
Initial catalog release: native scheduled synchronization of parental certifications and Parents Guide tags, with configurable dry runs and incremental state.

Translates the PostgreSQL dashboard, confirmation dialogs, errors, logs, health reports, migration output and documentation into English. Retains Jellyfin 12.4 compatibility, query-performance fixes, existing configuration and database state.
